tools.name: headlesson_search
tools.description: Find and compare CLI, MCP, and API apps by task, name, and confirmed axes. Known axis spelling aliases are normalized (licence to license, local_mcp_server to local_mcp, remote_mcp_server to remote_mcp); unrecognized axes are reported as unknown_axes. Private sources use an operator-provided or edit

tools.name: headlesson_get
tools.description: Get a recorded app, concept, protocol, usecase, feature, axes or search guide by ID. Private source tuples use non-URL source labels and grouped non-public exceptions; docs/homepage labels are not links. operator_own and lesson.tested retain their values but are operational observations excluded fro

tools.name: headlesson_whats_new
tools.description: List documented changes since a date, optionally by kind or affected record. Public source URLs remain; private sources use non-URL labels and grouped exceptions.

tools.name: headlesson_feedback
tools.description: This content is sent to the headlesson operator. Feedback about headlesson itself is sufficient. Do not include personal information or conversation contents.
